name: Improved Conductive Body
body:
Electricity energizes your nanites, accelerating your body’s self-repair routines.

Prerequisite: Con 15, Conductive Body, Toughness, android.

Benefit: Whenever you take electricity damage that exceeds your electricity resistance, you gain fast healing 1 for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution modifier.
